question.text: Which of the following according to LeChatelier's principle is correct?

options.text: Increase in temperature favours the endothermic reaction
Increase in temperature favours the exothermic reaction
Increase in pressure shifts the equilibrium in that side in which number of gaseous moles increases
All of the above are true

solution.text: According to Le-Chatelier's principle increase in temperature favours the endothermic reaction while decrease in temperature favour the exothermic reaction. Increase in pressure shifts the equilibrium in that side in which number of gaseous moles decreases.
